verdict.rationale: Temporal documents Worker Versioning and Workflow Definition updates that let new executions run updated code while in-flight ones continue on the original version (temporal-docs-13,14,29,34), and provides a Web UI/CLI to list and inspect workflow executions for review (temporal-gh-1,temporal-gh-2). Rollback capability is only evidenced via a community comment describing resetting a workflow's execution state to re-run from an earlier point (temporal-comm-8), not first-party documentation. missing for 10: vendor-documented rollback/reset workflow, a dedicated version-diff/review UI, and independent confirmation that rollback works reliably in production.
